text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no way to run commands here, so please run it to confirm everything passes.

- `fees.py`: the late fee added the daily rate to the days late. It now multiplies them.
- `members.py`: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- `factory.py`: `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies are my choice, since the tests only check the title.
- `books.py`: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.
- `search.py`: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports from `catalog.text`.
